profiles.name: Lee Chuan How
profiles.description: Lee Chuan How represents Ipoh Timor, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

profiles.name: M. Kulasegaran
profiles.position: Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Law and Institutional Reform)
profiles.description: M. Kulasegaran represents Ipoh Barat, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Law and Institutional Reform). A DAP member.

profiles.name: Sivakumar Varatharaju Naidu
profiles.description: Sivakumar Varatharaju Naidu represents Batu Gajah, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

milestones.title: Seek emergency funding for the Jalan Sri Kinta 1 floodgate
milestones.description: Lee pledged to submit an emergency mitigation funding request after inspecting the floodgate with drainage officials.
milestones.progress_note: Submission, approval and completed emergency work were not confirmed. The separate RM108 million Sungai Kinta Phase 2 scheme and its 2030 forecast are not completion of this request.

milestones.title: Create a taskforce to review the articled clerkship curriculum
milestones.description: Kulasegaran reported that the Legal Profession Qualifying Board had agreed to establish a taskforce to improve the curriculum.
milestones.progress_note: The board’s agreement is documented; formation of the taskforce and delivery of a revised curriculum were not established. This is a reported institutional undertaking, not the deputy minister’s sole delivery.

milestones.title: Distribute RM200,000 to 40 Batu Gajah mosques and suraus
milestones.description: The report records RM5,000 contributions to each institution through Sivakumar’s constituency initiative.
milestones.progress_note: A dated handover report for this Ramadan round. It does not verify how recipients spent the funds or completion of later annual rounds.

milestones.title: Work with education authorities on the new Ladang Jeram Tamil school building
milestones.description: Sivakumar committed to coordinating with the Education Ministry after the Budget 2026 allocation for SJK(T) Ladang Jeram.
milestones.progress_note: The personal statement announces cooperation and funding; a construction start, completion date and completed building were not independently confirmed. The ministry and implementing authorities share responsibility.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
